lines.text: Eliphaz the Temanite asks Job whether God rebukes him for his reverence, and says Job's wickedness is great.
Eliphaz says Job took clothing from the naked, withheld food from the famished, and crushed the strength of the fatherless.
Eliphaz says snares surround Job, and a swarm of locusts covers him in darkness.
Eliphaz says wicked men of old were snatched away before their time after they told God, 'Bless our houses.'
Eliphaz says if Job returns to the Almighty and removes injustice, the Almighty will be his gold and finest silver.
